title: IONTaxDetail
description: Indonesia-specific extension of RetailConsideration v2.1 breakup[].taxDetail. Inherits rate, included, and taxableBase; the containing breakup item's amount is the calculated tax amount.

taxRegime.description: Indonesian tax regime applied by this tax breakup entry. PPN is value-added tax; PPNBM is luxury-goods sales tax; PPH22 and PPH23 are withholding regimes; PPN_FINAL is final VAT for applicable categories; EXEMPT identifies a non-taxable transaction.

taxCategory.description: Indonesian taxable-supply classification. BKP identifies taxable goods, JKP identifies taxable services, and NON_BKP identifies goods or services outside those taxable categories.

eFakturRef.description: DJP e-Faktur reference for the tax entry, when an electronic Faktur Pajak has been issued. Format: XXX.XXX-YY.XXXXXXXX.
